# WebPage2Doc

> Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that turns any web page into PDF, DOCX or Markdown with images. Local-first: everything runs in the browser, no backend. Side panel UI in React, content extraction via @mozilla/readability.

## Docs
- [README (RU)](https://github.com/evangreen165/webpage2doc/blob/main/README.md): overview, install (Load unpacked), usage
- [README (EN)](https://github.com/evangreen165/webpage2doc/blob/main/README.en.md)
- [Architecture](https://github.com/evangreen165/webpage2doc/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): message flow, rendering, failure modes
- [Decisions](https://github.com/evangreen165/webpage2doc/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md): ADR log

## Capabilities
- Outputs: PDF (html2pdf.js), DOCX (docx), Markdown (turndown)
- Images: <img src>, data-src, srcset, CSS background-image -> images/ folder in ZIP
- Video: <video>/<iframe> -> "[Видео: url]" link, never downloaded
- Extraction: @mozilla/readability strips menus, banners, footers
- Limits: 200 images, 100 MB, ~50 PDF pages; SSRF is not applicable (no network egress besides the page)
- UI: side panel, RU/EN, dark theme, staged progress, 10-item localStorage history

## Interfaces
- chrome.tabs -> W2D_COLLECT message -> Snapshot (title, url, html, images[], videos[], warnings[])
- chrome.downloads.download(blob:...) -> webpage2doc/<slug>.<format>.zip
